mekanism_optimizer.config.enableUnlimite: Bypasses the 2.14 billion (Integer.MAX_VALUE) limit by performing multi-burst ejection loops in a single tick. (Default: false)
mekanism_optimizer.config.autoEjectBurst: Max Burst Ejection Multiplier Per Tick
Maximum burst iterations per tick for fluids, gases, and energy (e.g. 64 = up to 64x standard rate).
mekanism_optimizer.config.itemEjectTickD: Tick interval between item auto-ejection cycles. 0 unlocks Mekanism's default 10-tick delay to eject every tick.
mekanism_optimizer.config.itemEjectMaxSt: Max Item Stacks Ejected Per Tick
Maximum item stacks to eject in a single tick (e.g. 64 stacks = 4,096 items).
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableInventor: Caches adjacent target BlockEntities and capabilities in O(1) time to eliminate chunk lookups.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableTranspor: Caches logistical transporter paths and destination lookups.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableFastPois: Replaces iterative loops in radiation calculations with O(1) sampling.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableAdaptive: Adaptive tick backoff when ejectors or pipes encounter blocked targets.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableSolarLig: Caches skylight checks and skips nighttime solar raycasting instantly.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableElectric: Fast-path liquid fluid checks and throttling for Electric Pumps.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableDynamicN: Dynamic emit cooldown for empty or stalled networks.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableFastSimu: Fast simulated item insertion without full capability recreation.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enablePacketCo: Coalesces tile entity update packets to reduce bandwidth and client lag.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableOwnerChu: Puts anchor upgrades to sleep when the owner is offline.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableFactoryA: Zero-allocation auto-sort balancing for large Mekanism & Addon factories.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableMultiblo: Adaptive tick caching for multiblocks during steady states.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableAddonOpt: Enables performance optimizations for Astral Mekanism and Mekanism Extras.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableRadiatio: O(1) instant bypass for entity radiation calculations when world has no active radiation.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableCableBac: Adaptive backoff for cables when targets are fully charged.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableLookingA: Caches unit display formatting for Jade and HUD tooltips.
mekanism_optimizer.config.maxBackoffTick: Maximum ticks to back off when an ejection target is continuously blocked.
mekanism_optimizer.config.solarLightCach: Time-to-live in ticks for cached skylight visibility.
mekanism_optimizer.config.dynamicNetwork: Cooldown ticks before re-checking stalled networks.
mekanism_optimizer.config.logIntervalSec: Interval in seconds for performance statistics logging (0 to disable).
